findings.description: Decisions 191 and 196 had already landed, and this PR rewrites their text in place (191's allowLocalBinding paragraph and ceiling 5, 196's ceiling 3) when it should add a dated amendment or a new decision with `Amends:`.
findings.body:
The ADR README rules out rewriting a landed decision: "Once a decision has landed, a later change appends an amendment section to it (dated, with the PR) or adds a new decision that links back through `Amends:`. It does not rewrite the landed text." ([docs/adr/README.md L19-21](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/a2aaecca7b392307e7002da376773157b179600d/docs/adr/README.md#L19-L21))

Decisions 191 and 196 are both on main already. This PR still rewrites them in place:
- 191's paragraph "`allowLocalBinding` stays on, at a cost…" now reads "is off…" ([L131-142](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/a2aaecca7b392307e7002da376773157b179600d/docs/adr/0191-a-worker-s-bash-calls-can-run-in-claude-code-s.md#L131-L142)).
- 191's ceiling 5 is replaced ([L349-351](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/a2aaecca7b392307e7002da376773157b179600d/docs/adr/0191-a-worker-s-bash-calls-can-run-in-claude-code-s.md#L349-L351)).
- 196's ceiling 3 is edited ([L101-105](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/a2aaecca7b392307e7002da376773157b179600d/docs/adr/0196-a-sandboxed-worker-gets-no-unix-socket-so-tests.md#L101-L105)).

The inline dates help, but they don't name the PR, and an inline date is not an amendment section. As it stands, the record of what was decided on 2026-11-16 is overwritten.

To fix this, restore the landed text, then do one of these:
- Append a dated `## Amendment (2026-11-17, #371)` section to 191 and to 196 that records `allowLocalBinding` going off and the switch to injected requests.
- Add a new decision with `Amends:` links to 191 and 196.

findings.description: ADR 91 still says the dashboard tests run "over a real socket, the url is on 127.0.0.1". After this PR they inject requests over in-memory duplexPair streams. Updating it to "over in-memory connections (decision 191)" would keep readers from expecting a loopback listen.
